symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description: Tickers or Yahoo quote URLs: stocks (AAPL), ETFs (SPY), indexes (^GSPC), crypto (BTC-USD), currencies (EURUSD=X), futures (CL=F), foreign listings (VOD.L, 7203.T). One full quote row each.

screeners.title: Screeners
screeners.description: Yahoo research screener ids or URLs, e.g. undervalued_growth_stocks, growth_technology_stocks, aggressive_small_caps, most_shorted_stocks, undervalued_large_caps, small_cap_gainers. Top 100 each.

listDetails.title: Full quote for each list row
listDetails.description: Fetch the full quote (fundamentals, analysts, profile) for every symbol in the lists and screeners, charged as quote rows. Off = the list's own columns.

maxListRows.title: Rows per list
maxListRows.description: Top N of each list or screener, up to 100.
